text: はいれる　のは　チケットの　ある　かた　だけです

structure.jp: チケットの　ある　かた　だけです
structure.en: are only people who have a ticket

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns it into 'the one who does it', so the sentence can talk about that. はいれる　のは = 'the ones who can enter are...'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: チケットの　ある　かた
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a noun describes that noun; inside such a phrase の can stand in for が. チケットの　ある　かた = 'people who have a ticket'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing はいる to はいれる turns 'enter' into 'can enter'. はいれる = 'can enter'.
